mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_COMMENT ( post_id, author_member_id, content, status ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{authorMemberId}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.author_member_id AS authorMemberId, c.content, c.status, c.created_at AS createdAt, u.user_name AS writerNickname FROM BOARD_COMMENT c JOIN USER u ON c.author_member_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.comment_id ASC
SELECT comment_id AS commentId, post_id AS postId, author_member_id AS authorMemberId, content, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM BOARD_COMMENT WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
